scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const port=process.env.PORT||5173,root=process.cwd(),types={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent((req.url||'/').split('?')[0]);let f=path.resolve(root,u==='/'?'index.html':'.'+u);if(!f.startsWith(root)||!fs.existsSync(f)){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found')}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':types[path.extname(f)]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res)}).listen(port,()=>console.log('AI Guru server running at http://localhost:'+port))"
scripts.build: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/services/aiGuru.js && node --check src/prompts/guardrails.js && node --check server/src/index.js && node --check server/src/routes/ai.js && node --check server/src/routes/student.js && node --check server/src/services/studentStore.js
